notes.title: Update v1.1.5
notes.content:
- Increased initial movement speed from 100 to 110
 - Increased base attack speed 
 - Reduced the stamina required to use dash from 95 to 90
 - Reduced the stamina multiplier required for lethal assault from 2x to 1.8x
 - Reduced the stamina multiplier required for tectonic shift from 1.5x to 1.4x

notes.title: Update v1.1.4
notes.content:
Listening to community feedback, I reduced the grind significantly

Enemies have less HP, less damage, give a little more XP and Gold

I'm always looking for your feedback, thank you very much.

notes.title: Update v1.1.3
notes.content: - Now you can remap your keyboard keys in Options menu

notes.title: Update v1.1.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused it to attack without stopping
 - The attack when pressed and held has been improved, making it no longer necessary to press again when taking damage

notes.title: Update V.1.1.1
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that caused the game to not start in the same language as Steam

notes.title: Update V.1.1.0
notes.content:
As many of you asked me, I changed the way the attack works!

 - Now you no longer need to hold down the button to attack, just press (You can still hold the button if you want)

 - inicial attack speed from 110 to 120
 - inicial max mana from 600 to 800
 - Dash stamina cost from 100 to 95
 - Jump stamina cost from 20 to 15
 - stamina recovery + 32,5%

I'll update the game as I receive your feedback, thank you all very much!
